answer: The canyon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
